agent_report.summary: Implemented Issue #20 (deadlines with approaching-work surfacing): added a top-level `deadlines` list in state.js with a read-normalizing `getDeadlines` accessor (sorted by due date, no version bump), add/toggle/remove functions, and pure `deadlineLabel`/`approachingSummary` helpers using a shared 7-day threshold and a fresh `todayKey()` at render time. Wired a new "Upcoming" panel in app.js/index.html with native date input, validation, confirm-before-delete, and a live summary line. Folded in two accepted PR #19 findings: wrapped `.panels`, the week panel, and the new Upcoming panel inside a `<main>` landmark, and made the week heading name non-current weeks. Documented all decisions in DECISIONS.md. Added 15 Playwright tests; all 57 tests pass locally. Opened PR #21 (branch `ant/issue-20`) closing #20.
